summary: Every existing release smoke and the full test suite were re-run after W-59. The four release JARs load together in a clean server and assemble the complete 458-value release SERVER snapshot; the development paired/rejection smokes stay core-only and prove handshake, rejection and config apply.

environment.mode: development world restored after earlier sessions; no new tests added
environment.poller: scripts/wait-for-log-line.sh (tail -F into a FIFO, <=60 s per call, sliced by each gate's own deadline)

gates.name: packaged
gates.marker: fabric-packaged-smoke: PASSED (Mekanism and Team Reborn Energy loaded, config/network/registry/heat/data-map/chemical proofs passed, and server reached Done)
gates.detail: clean fabric-server-launch.jar; 50 mods; mekanism + mekanismadditions + mekanismgenerators + mekanismtools; server config snapshot configs=10 values=458; Done (4.240s)

gates.name: paired
gates.marker: fabric-paired-network-smoke: PASSED (two fresh clients completed configuration negotiation and joined play)
gates.detail: core-only development run; both sessions handshake on Netty; send/client_applied values=304

gates.name: rejection
gates.marker: fabric-configuration-rejection-smoke: PASSED (version mismatch, same-version client rejection, and missing receiver were rejected before play)

gates.name: recipe
gates.marker: PASS (real recipe load, generic cache, hot-epoch stability, reload advance/retention, client tail-mixin epochs, reconnect freshness, fixture isolation passed)

gates.name: chemical
gates.marker: PASS (real post-snapshot configuration abort cleanup, no stale revival, registry/remap, attributes, true-long codecs, disconnect and same-JVM reconnect passed)

gates.name: worldgen

gates.name: tile
gates.marker: PASS (initial chunk reduced tag, vanilla BE packet dispatched through onDataPacket not bypassing it, custom update_tile payload through its own receiver, full-load separation, vanilla control block entity, owner-world reconnect, fixture isolation)

gates.name: datamap
gates.marker: PASS (epochs 1-4, layered failure semantics, fixture-induced reload failure stability, and stop cleanup)

gates.name: client-window

gate_repairs.defect: The release-JAR check still forbade data/mekanism/recipe/, the same rule retired from fabric-packaged-smoke.sh in e6ceaca2 (C-2 keeps an inventory instead). Production recipe data legitimately ships.
gate_repairs.fix: Keep forbidding the fixture recipe type, serializer and classes; drop only the production-recipe clause; comment names the approved retirement.

gate_repairs.defect: The fixture's copied META-INF/services list was frozen at four descriptors; since the Task040 service layer the bootstraps resolve more providers, so the probe died at start with 'No provider found for Mekanism service mekanism.api.radiation.IRadiationManager'.
gate_repairs.fix: One shared mekanismServiceDescriptors list now drives jar packaging, the fixture's copied descriptors and the isolation guard's byte comparison. IMekanismAccess stays excluded by design.

gate_repairs.defect: Crash signatures treated vanilla 'No data fixer registered for <id>' ERROR lines (Util.java:268, emitted for every modded entity type) as failures.
gate_repairs.fix: Exclude that single vanilla message from the crash/ERROR accounting checks; every other ERROR still fails the gate.

c1_to_c4.c1_negative_probes: evidence/p8-release/negative-probes.json (test-class, NeoForge namespace and resource-SHA probes each FAIL on a disposable copy)

not_claimed: No four-module client handshake exists in this environment: Loom dev class groups duplicate core registry statics (evidence/p8-release/w60-dev-classloader.json), and no packaged client launcher is available. Four-module release coverage is the clean four-JAR server start plus the 458-value snapshot assertion.
